raw_problem.problem_text:
*设在曲线坐标（ $q ^ { 1 } q ^ { 2 } q ^ { 3 }$ ）中线元 ds 表为

$$
d s ^ {2} = g _ {i k} d q ^ {i} d q ^ {k}
$$

写出这曲线坐标中的薛定谔方程式，写出球面坐标系中的薛定谔方程式。
raw_problem.solution_text:
$d x = \frac { \hat { \alpha } x } { \hat { \sigma } q _ { 1 } } d q _ { 1 } + \frac { \hat { \alpha } x } { \hat { \sigma } q _ { 2 } } d q _ { 2 } + \frac { \hat { \alpha } x } { \hat { \sigma } q _ { 3 } }$ 1dq  2dq  同样关于 y,z 有类似的二式。（这里为书写方便 q 的上3q标改成下标。）

*参看 Amer.J.Phys.Vol.41.1973-11

$$
\begin{array}{l} d s ^ {2} = d x ^ {2} + d y ^ {2} + d z ^ {2} = \left[ \left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {1}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {1}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {1}}\right) ^ {1} \right] d q _ {1} ^ {2} \\ + \left[ \left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {2}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {2}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {2}}\right) ^ {1} \right] d q _ {2} ^ {2} \\ + \left[ \left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {3}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {3}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {3}}\right) ^ {1} \right] d q _ {3} ^ {2} \\ + 2 \left[ \frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {1}} \frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {2}} + \frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {1}} \frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {2}} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {1}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {2}} \right] d q _ {1} d q _ {2} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} + 2 \left[ \frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {2}} \frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {3}} + \frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {2}} \frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {3}} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {3}} \right] d q _ {2} d q _ {3} \\ + 2 \left[ \frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {3}} \frac {\partial x}{\partial q _ {1}} + \frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {3}} \frac {\partial y}{\partial q _ {1}} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {3}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial q _ {1}} \right] d q _ {3} d q _ {1} \\ \end{array}
$$

令 （ ）ik xxg    $g _ { i k } = \sum _ { x y z } ( \frac { \hat { \sigma } x } { \hat { \sigma } q _ { i } } \frac { \hat { \sigma } x } { \hat { \sigma } q _ { k } } )$ 为坐标变换系数：

设沿曲线坐标等势面的单位矢量是 $\vec { a } _ { 1 }$ ， $\vec { a } _ { 2 }$ ， ${ \vec { a } } _ { 3 }$ 则

$$
\begin{array}{l} \operatorname {g r a d} \Psi = \nabla \Psi = \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial x} \vec {i} + \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial y} \vec {j} + \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial z} \vec {k} \\ = \frac {\bar {a} _ {1}}{g _ {1 1}} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial q _ {1}} + \frac {\bar {a} _ {2}}{g _ {2 2}} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial q _ {2}} + \frac {\bar {a} _ {3}}{g _ {3 3}} \frac {\nabla \Psi}{\partial q _ {3}} \\ = \frac {1}{g _ {1 1} g _ {2 2} g _ {3 3}} \left[ \vec {a} _ {1} \frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {1}} \left(g _ {2 2} g _ {3 3} \Psi\right) + \dots \right] \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \nabla^ {2} \Psi = d i v \left(g r a d \Psi\right) = \frac {1}{g _ {1 1} g _ {2 2} g _ {3 3}} \left\{\frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {1}} \left[ \frac {g _ {2 2} g _ {3 3}}{g _ {1 1}} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial q _ {1}} \right] \right. \\ + \frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {2}} \left[ \frac {g _ {3 3} g _ {1 1}}{g _ {2 2}} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial q _ {2}} \right] + \frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {3}} \left[ \frac {g _ {1 1} g _ {2 2}}{g _ {3 3}} \frac {\partial \Psi}{\partial q _ {3}} \right] \} \tag {1} \\ \end{array}
$$

代入直角坐标薛定谔方程式：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hbar i \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \Psi^ {\prime} \left(q _ {1} q _ {2} q _ {3} t\right) = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m g _ {1 1} g _ {2 2} g _ {3 3}} \left\{\frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {1}} \left[ \frac {g _ {2 2} g _ {3 3}}{g _ {1 1}} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial q _ {2}} \right] + \frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {2}} \left[ \frac {g _ {1 1} g _ {3 3}}{g _ {2 2}} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial q _ {2}} \right] \right. \\ + \frac {\partial}{\partial q _ {3}} \left[ \frac {g _ {1 1} g _ {2 2}}{g _ {3 3}} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial q _ {2}} \right] \} + V ^ {\prime} \left(q _ {1} q _ {2} q _ {3}\right) \Psi^ {\prime} \left(q _ {1} q _ {2} q _ {3} t\right) \tag {2} \\ \end{array}
$$

但 ${ \Psi } ^ { \prime } { \left( { { q } _ { 1 } } { { q } _ { 2 } } { { q } _ { 3 } } t \right) } = { \Psi } \{ x { \left( { { q } _ { 1 } } { { q } _ { 2 } } { { q } _ { 3 } } \right) } , ~ y { \left( { { q } _ { 1 } } { { q } _ { 2 } } { { q } _ { 3 } } \right) } , ~ z { \left( { { q } _ { 1 } } { { q } _ { 2 } } { { q } _ { 3 } } \right) } , ~ t \}$

$$
V ^ {\prime} = V \left\{x \left(q _ {1} q _ {2} q _ {3}\right) \dots \right\}
$$

在球坐标情形 $x = r \sin \theta \cos \psi$ ， $y = r \sin \theta \sin \psi$ ， $z = r \cos \theta$ 式正交坐标系

$$
g _ {1 1} = \sqrt {\left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial r}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial y}{\partial r}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial r}\right) ^ {2}} = 1
$$

$$
g _ {2 2} = \sqrt {\left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial \theta}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial y}{\partial \theta}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial \theta}\right) ^ {2}} = r
$$

$$
g _ {3 3} = \sqrt {\left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial \psi}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial y}{\partial \psi}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial \psi}\right) ^ {2}} = r \sin \theta
$$

代入后得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hbar i \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial t} = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m r ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta} \left\{\frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(r ^ {2} \sin \theta \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial r}\right) + \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial \theta}\right) \right. \\ + \frac {\partial}{\partial \psi} \left(\frac {1}{\sin \theta} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial \psi}\right) \} + V ^ {\prime} (r, \theta , \psi) \Psi^ {\prime} \\ \end{array}
$$

化简得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hbar i \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial t} = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m r ^ {2}} \left\{\frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(r ^ {2} \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial r}\right) + \frac {1}{\sin \theta} \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial \theta}\right) \right. \\ + \frac {1}{\sin^ {2} \theta} \frac {\partial}{\partial \psi} \left(\frac {\partial \Psi^ {\prime}}{\partial \psi}\right) \} + V ^ {\prime} (r, \theta , \psi) \Psi^ {\prime} \\ \end{array}
$$
